A '''city''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nathema]]. [[Meetra Surik]] landed the ''[[Ebon Hawk]]'' there and accessed the city's databases to discover the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] fate.<ref name="Revan">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref>
